items.t: Archer Aviation Slides 6% Despite Cathie Wood’s Second Straight Day of Buying; Joby Aviation Falls 4%, EHang Declines 2% Despite Sri Lanka Milestone
items.sum: Cathie Wood keeps buying, Boeing's deal is nearly done, and Joby just raised its outlook, yet air taxi stocks still slump together. What does the sector's shared slide say about who gets hurt when risk appetite fades?
